instructions: Does this part of the system prompt tell the model how to behave, or only give it information?

options.label: tells_it_how_to_behave
options.criterion: an instruction about what the model should do or how it should answer

options.label: only_information
options.criterion: facts, context or a record, with no instruction about behaviour

options.label: both
options.criterion: a behavioural instruction and information in the same text

options.label: unclear
options.criterion: none of these fits the text
